title: Noodling Nudibranch
statement: A small, frilly sea slug whose rippling cerata glow from dusky violet to warm lantern-gold whenever it's mulling something over, which is nearly always. It spends its days in a twilight-blue tank of swaying seagrass, patiently arranging pebbles into thoughtful little spirals, and it pauses to regard each visitor with curiosity, as though you've just asked it a question worth taking seriously.
